fixtures.prompt: 收工。本 session 修复了 validation repair-loop 漏掉 empty panel list 的问题，根因是 schema guard 在 export 前才运行；我们比较过 export fallback 和 upfront validation，最后选择把 deterministic schema check 前移。

entry.summary: Moved schema guard before export so validation repair loops catch empty panel lists earlier
entry.context: The repair loop missed empty panel lists because schema guarding only ran at export time. The session compared export fallback with upfront validation and chose the earlier deterministic check.
entry.impact: Future weekly reports can explain the reliability fix without reading implementation commits.
entry.motivation: Empty panel lists escaped validation until export, making the repair loop harder to reason about.
entry.root_cause: Schema guard ran at export time instead of before the validation repair loop.
exploration_paths: Keep export fallback -> catches failures late but preserves existing flow
Move upfront validation before repair loop -> catches empty panel lists earlier and clarifies ownership
abandoned_alternatives: Export fallback only: rejected because it keeps schema failures hidden until export
open_questions: Should repair-loop latency be tracked at validation-stage level?

assertions.description: The root cause explains that schema guarding happened too late in the flow.

assertions.name: alternatives_preserved

raw_entries.summary: Split storyboard validation into deterministic schema checks and LLM-assisted repair loops
raw_entries.context: Single-pass validation hid recurring panel continuity failures until export time. The split gives future debugging a stable contract boundary.
raw_entries.motivation: Export-time validation made failures expensive to debug and blurred repair ownership.
exploration_paths: Keep repair logic in export -> lower migration cost but preserves hidden ownership
Move deterministic schema checks before repair loop -> clearer contract boundary
raw_entries.impact: Weekly outline can explain the validation ownership split without reading implementation commits.

artifact_context.scope: Validation-stage ownership between schema checks, repair loops, and export compatibility.
artifact_context.delta: Recorded export as a consumer rather than a hidden repair stage.
open_questions: Whether repair-loop latency needs a separate budget.

fixtures.prompt: 用 /lode:query 回答：为什么 validation repair ownership 留在 validation stage？
fixtures.expected_behavior: Build `{vault}/raw/decisions/{slug}.json` as a derived decision replay index and return a compact query evidence pack grounded in source raw entries. The answer must identify the validation-stage ownership decision, cite `source_entry_refs`, preserve confidence labels, include the rejected orchestration-level alternative, and avoid inventing facts outside raw entries.

assertions.name: derived_index_schema
assertions.description: The generated index uses schema_version `lode.decision_replay.v1` with nodes, edges, and mandatory `source_entry_refs` on every node.

assertions.name: query_pack_grounded
assertions.description: The query output uses schema_version `lode.decision_query.v1`, returns `answerable=true`, and includes top_nodes with raw source entry references.

assertions.name: rejected_alternative_preserved
assertions.description: The query pack preserves the rejected orchestration-level repair ownership alternative and its reason.

assertions.name: query_answerability_metadata
assertions.description: The query pack includes `matched_terms`, `evidence_strength`, and `answerability_reason` so downstream agents can explain why the answer is supported.

fixtures.prompt: 用 /lode:query 回答：why retry budget policy

assertions.name: explicit_decision_thread_preferred

assertions.name: top_node_metadata_preserved
